newsitem.title: USA: CSX CEO sees higher Q3 earnings.
newsitem.headline: CSX CEO sees higher Q3 earnings.

text.p: CSX chairman John Snow said on Thursday he expected his transportation company's earnings this third quarter would top its 1995 third quarter.
Snow, at a news conference, also said he expected more consolidations in the railroad industry in the coming years.
Asked about CSX's third quarter earnings, he said the firm "was lookng for another good year, an improvement over the third quarter of 1995.
Its earnings for the third quarter of 1995 were $1.92 per share before its split, and .96 following. Snow gave no estimate of the expected third quarter 1996 earnings.

Asked about future railroad mergers following the merger this summer of the two big western lines Union Pacific Corp. and Southern Pacific Rail Corp., Snow said, "There is going to be further consolidation."
"The railroad industry in the next two-three years will look quite a big different than it does today," he added.
Asked what role CSX would play, he said, "We'll be an acquirer if that best advances our interests."
